description: List test plans (TP-*) with status, dates and run counts; paginated. Needs a project id (PR-*); no tool lists projects, so get it from the capability functions. Creating a test plan or sub-plan, and linking or unlinking test runs, are not available as tools here: use the capability functions (they ask you to confirm first).

project_identifier.description: Identifier of the project to fetch test plans from (starts with PR- followed by a number).

name: listTestPlans
